findings.title: RateLimitError::retry_after dropped by From<GenerationError> for AlephError
findings.description: The From boundary flattened GenerationError::RateLimitError { message, retry_after } into AlephError::rate_limit(message), permanently discarding the upstream Retry-After hint.
findings.trigger: Provider returns 429 with Retry-After: 30. Caller cannot sleep 30s.
findings.suggested_fix: Fold the duration into the suggestion string. AlephError::RateLimitError has no retry_after field of its own.

findings.title: SerializationError mapped to AlephError::IoError — wrong classifier
findings.description: JSON decode failures wrapped as IoError tripped downstream classifiers that key on IoError for transport retries, looping on a payload that will never parse differently on retry.
findings.trigger: Provider returns 200 with malformed payload.
findings.suggested_fix: Map to AlephError::other(message).

findings.title: ProviderError status_code and provider dropped by From<GenerationError>
findings.description: Same From site. status_code (Option<u16>) and provider (String) were discarded, so the retry classifier lost the HTTP status distinction.
findings.trigger: Provider returns HTTP 503. After Aleph conversion it is indistinguishable from a 400.
findings.suggested_fix: Inject '(provider: X) (HTTP Y)' into the message.

findings.title: GenerationProviderRegistry::contains does not consult canonical_index
findings.description: contains() checked providers.contains_key; get() falls back to canonical_index. A contains+get.unwrap() guard silently missed canonical-name aliases.
findings.trigger: Caller checks for canonical-name presence; provider registered under a config section name.
findings.suggested_fix: self.providers.contains_key(name) || self.canonical_index.contains_key(name)

findings.title: DownloadError always classified as retryable regardless of HTTP status
findings.description: is_retryable returned true for every DownloadError, but the variant only carried message and url. A 404 on an expired signed URL or a 403 on a region-locked asset burned the full retry budget.
findings.trigger: Provider returns a signed URL that has since expired.
findings.suggested_fix: Add status_code: Option<u16> to DownloadError; gate is_retryable on None (transport) or Some(500..=599)|408.

findings.title: ReplicateProviderBuilder::build returns Self (not Result) and unwrap_or_default's reqwest build
findings.description: build() returned ReplicateProvider directly and used unwrap_or_default() on reqwest::Client::builder().build(). If reqwest build ever failed (TLS backend init, invalid system proxy), the resulting Client has no timeout and no other builder-level config.
findings.trigger: reqwest::Client::builder() returns Err on unusual TLS / DNS resolver configurations.
findings.suggested_fix: Change build() to retain the silent-fallback path; add try_build() returning GenerationResult<ReplicateProvider>; route the factory arm through try_build.

findings.title: voice_http_client hardening only used by 2 of ~8 voice-path providers
findings.description: Module docstring claims voice_http_client (pool_max_idle_per_host(0) + connect_timeout(8s)) applies to 'every voice-path provider'. Only openai_tts and azure_speech use it; the remaining 6+ use WithRequestTimeout::with_timeout → generation_http_client, which keeps the default pool. The load-balancer bug the docstring cites applies identically to those endpoints.
findings.trigger: Speech provider running against 302.ai or similar LB drops idle sockets; non-hardened voice providers exhibit the leading-sentence-eaten bug under burst load.
findings.suggested_fix: Thread voice_http_client through WithRequestTimeout so every voice-path provider inherits the policy in one place. OR update the docstring to reflect opt-in reality.
findings.deferred_reason: Mechanically simple but high-blast-radius (six provider modules). Better done in a dedicated voice-policy pass.

findings.title: openai_whisper::load_local symlink-to-absolute path traversal
findings.description: load_local rejected absolute paths or '..' segments in the INPUT, allow-listed audio extensions, then canonicalized and rejected canonical paths containing ParentDir. The ParentDir-in-canonical check fails to catch a symlink pointing at an absolute target: canonicalize returns /etc/audio.mp3 (no '..', no ParentDir); the read proceeds.
findings.trigger: LLM-controlled request.prompt or params.reference_audio set to look.mp3; CWD contains a writable symlink of the same stem pointing at /etc/audio.mp3.
findings.suggested_fix: After canonicalize, reject any canonical path that does not starts_with(CWD). Fallback to is_absolute() rejection if CWD cannot be canonicalized.

findings.title: retry_transient has exactly one production caller
findings.description: Generic retry helper (3 attempts, 250ms/750ms backoff, respects Retry-After) has only one production caller: openai_image.rs. Eighteen other providers' 429/5xx/timeout/network transient errors are NOT retried.
findings.trigger: Brief network blip on any non-DALL-E provider → failed job instead of self-healed one.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap each provider's generate body in retry_transient(...) the same way openai_image does.
findings.deferred_reason: Mechanical refactor across 18 providers; high-blast-radius. Better done in a dedicated retry-adoption pass.

findings.title: factory.rs 'Unknown provider_type' error message omits volcengine_tts
findings.description: factory.rs:182-211 has an arm for volcengine_tts, but the catch-all error message lists supported providers without it.
findings.trigger: Operator fat-fingers provider_type; suggested-list tells them the wrong thing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add volcengine_tts to the supported-list string.

findings.title: openai_compat edit_image branch has a dead unwrap_or
findings.description: reference_image.find(',') returns Some(idx) where idx < len; reference_image.get(idx + 1..) is therefore always Some. The unwrap_or(reference_image) branch is dead.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace unwrap_or with &reference_image[idx + 1..].
findings.deferred_reason: No-op cleanup; not a behaviour bug. Noted as a flag for clippy cleanup.

findings.title: api_key empty-string accepted by 6 builders (factory-level guard recommended)
findings.description: Factory rejects None but accepts Some(''). Six builders (OpenAiImageProvider, StabilityImageProvider, GoogleImagenProvider, MidjourneyProviderBuilder, ReplicateProviderBuilder, FalProviderBuilder) do not check for empty strings.
findings.trigger: Operator typo leaves api_key = ''.
findings.suggested_fix: Add api_key.trim().is_empty() guard at the factory gate so all 18 arms inherit it.

findings.title: volcengine_tts resolve_endpoint accepts arbitrary host — SSRF via configuration
findings.description: resolve_endpoint parses base_url by split_once('?') and uses the path verbatim as the API host. No scheme enforcement, no host allow-list.
findings.trigger: Operator typo or hostile config layer pointing base_url at internal hosts.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate scheme is https:// and host is openspeech.bytedance.com (or operator-supplied allow-list).
findings.deferred_reason: Operator-controlled but defense-in-depth gap; needs config-layer review alongside other SSRF surfaces.

findings.title: Fal/BFL/Stability/Google model_path interpolated into URL without charset validation
findings.description: fal/mod.rs:245-263, bfl/mod.rs:106-107, stability.rs:186-189, google_imagen.rs:172-173, google_veo/provider.rs:125-127 all format! the model name into the URL path with no charset validation.
findings.trigger: Future code path that exposes params.model to the LLM.
findings.suggested_fix: Add validate_path_segment(s) helper in http.rs (allow-list [a-zA-Z0-9._/-], length cap ≤ 256, reject .. and absolute prefixes).
findings.deferred_reason: Defense-in-depth; no current exploit path. Bundle with the SSRF guard above.

findings.title: probe.rs returns hard-coded Chinese user-visible strings to RPC clients
findings.description: probe.rs:111,118,124,128,132,147 — every user-visible message is Chinese. The rest of the codebase is English.
findings.trigger: User runs generation_providers.test from a non-Chinese UI locale.
findings.suggested_fix: Return structured { success, code, http_status } from GenerationProbeOutcome; let the gateway handler apply i18n.
findings.deferred_reason: i18n concern, not a correctness bug. Worth a dedicated i18n pass on probe surfaces.

findings.title: is_retryable() excludes HTTP 408 (Request Timeout)
findings.description: is_retryable matched Some(500..=599) and Some(429), but not 408. HTTP 408 is the canonical retryable status (RFC 7231 §6.5.7).
findings.trigger: Upstream returns 408 Request Timeout.
findings.suggested_fix: Add | Self::ProviderError { status_code: Some(408), .. } to the matches!().

findings.title: retry_after formatted as 'wait 0 seconds' when sub-second
findings.description: user_friendly_message rendered duration.as_secs() directly. A 500ms retry_after displays 'wait 0 seconds'.
findings.trigger: Provider returns Retry-After: 0.5.
findings.suggested_fix: Render 'wait {n} ms' for sub-second, 'wait {n} seconds' for ≥1s, 'wait a moment' for exactly zero.

findings.title: MockGenerationProvider re-exported via pub in production module
findings.description: pub struct MockGenerationProvider (no #[cfg(test)]) sits in mod.rs and is reachable from any binary.
findings.trigger: Future production caller accidentally imports MockGenerationProvider.
findings.suggested_fix: Mark #[doc(hidden)] so rustdoc suppresses it; alternatively gate behind #[cfg(test)].

findings.title: No size cap on response-body download across ~8 providers
findings.description: response.bytes().await without Content-Length check or streamed cap on 8+ providers. A hostile upstream can OOM the process.
findings.trigger: Compromised upstream or accidental 5GB response.
findings.suggested_fix: Use safe_fetch (which gates SSRF + size) for any URL the provider doesn't construct, or check Content-Length pre-read.
findings.deferred_reason: OOM-only risk on adversarial input. Bundle with retry_transient adoption and size-cap unification.

findings.title: Veo & Midjourney download bytes have no size cap
findings.description: Same as above, scoped to veo/midjourney specifically.
findings.suggested_fix: Streamed download with hard cap.

findings.title: Polling upper bounds use attempt counters, not wall-clock deadlines (3 of 4)
findings.description: Replicate, Midjourney, Google Veo bound polling by attempt count. Fal correctly uses wall-clock deadline.
findings.trigger: Long-running generation exceeding N×interval seconds.
findings.suggested_fix: Convert attempt counters to wall-clock deadlines matching the fal pattern.
findings.deferred_reason: Low-impact; fal is the only high-volume path today. Worth bundling with retry-adoption.

findings.title: Dead trait surface on GenerationProvider (check_progress, cancel, edit_image, supports_image_editing)
findings.description: Four trait methods implemented only by one or two providers; no caller invokes them via dyn dispatch.
findings.trigger: Future code attempts to call these methods and silently gets the default impl returning UnsupportedFeature.
findings.suggested_fix: Either wire them into the actual gateway request flows or remove the trait methods that no consumer reaches.
findings.deferred_reason: Dead-surface cleanup; needs gateway-side wiring decision.

findings.title: Dead error-classifier API on GenerationError
findings.description: Five methods (needs_user_action, should_fallback, retry_after, provider_name, user_friendly_message) defined as pub on error.rs; four have zero non-test callers.
findings.suggested_fix: Either wire the classifiers into the gateway / handler code that currently re-derives them, or remove the unreferenced methods.
findings.deferred_reason: Dead-surface cleanup; needs gateway-side wiring decision.

findings.title: Connection-error mapping collapses TLS/decode/redirect to flat string (9 providers)
findings.description: Same if e.is_timeout() / e.is_connect() / else-Network pattern repeats across 9 providers; the else branch swallows TLS/decode/redirect errors into a single generic Network.
findings.trigger: TLS handshake failure surfaces as plain Network.
findings.suggested_fix: Add e.is_decode() || e.is_redirect() → distinct retryable markers.

notes: 11 P1 / 6 P2 / 6 P3 findings, 11 fixed in this pass. Largest module by yield — the From<GenerationError> data-loss cluster (3 P1s) was the highest-leverage single-point fix. Two P1s (voice_http_client adoption, retry_transient adoption) deferred due to high blast radius across 6+ providers each — both flagged for a dedicated voice-policy pass and a retry-adoption pass respectively. Three P2s deferred (probe i18n, SSRF model validation) need config-layer cross-cutting review.
